tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search ~460,000 active US hospital/healthcare jobs (staff and permanent roles). Returns up to 20 matches with title, employer, city and state, the pay when the posting lists it, the state license a licensed role needs, and a link to the job page. Jobs with verified-working apply links rank first.

query.description: Keywords: role, title, employer, or city (e.g. "ICU nurse", "pharmacist", "CHRISTUS")

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX

tools.name: search_travel_contracts
tools.description: Search ~127,000 active US travel nursing / allied health contracts with weekly pay. Highest-paying first. Links go to the contract page on Waypoint, which names the staffing agency and links to its posting.

min_weekly_pay.description: Minimum gross weekly pay in USD, e.g. 2500

tools.name: get_hospital_wages
tools.description: Hourly pay ranges (nursing, allied health, imaging, NP/PA) for a US hospital system covering 433 US hospital systems (3,978 hospitals), last updated November 2026. Search by system name.
